profile.name: PICA 启动器应用
profile.description: 这是一个用于实验室计算机的桌面启动工具，用来集中展示并启动 PICA 相关脚本和实用程序，同时提供说明文档、手册、许可证、更新信息、代码仓库链接和脚本目录的访问入口，并带有 GPIB 测试功能。它更像实验软件资源的统一入口，而不是一台物理实验仪器。
profile.description_en: This is a desktop launcher utility for a laboratory computer that centralizes access to PICA-related scripts and utilities. It provides entry points to documentation, manuals, license information, update notes, repository links, script folders, and a GPIB test function. It is best understood as a lab software launcher rather than a physical instrument.
